info.name: PromoQuoter API
info.description: Cart pricing and stock reservation service. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner): the create requests save ids into collection variables that later requests use. Start the service first with ./mvnw spring-boot:run (http://localhost:8080). Every error is an RFC 7807 problem with code, requestId and errors[].

request.description: Actuator health endpoint. Returns UP when the service is running.

Creates one or more products in a single all-or-nothing batch (1 to 100). Category is trimmed and upper-cased; price has at most 2 decimals and 10 integer digits. Saves productId (Mug) and lampId (Lamp).

response.name: 400 - validation errors, one entry per field
400 - unknown field is rejected

exec: pm.test("Page metadata present", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("content"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("totalElements"); });

request.description: Paged list. Query: page (0-based), size (max 100, default 20), sort (createdAt, name or price; add ,desc), category (case-insensitive).

request.description: Returns one product including its current stock.

item.name: Create promotions (percent off + buy X get Y)

request.description: Creates promotions in one batch. Each entry has a "type": PERCENT_OFF_CATEGORY (category, percent) or BUY_X_GET_Y (productId, buyQty, freeQty). Optional: priority, active, eligibleSegments (REGULAR, VIP, EMPLOYEE; empty means everyone). Saves percentPromoId and bxgyPromoId.

response.name: 201 - Create promotions (percent off + buy X get Y)
400 - validation errors
422 - unknown product
400 - unknown promotion type

request.description: Returns one promotion with its rule parameters.
Changes only the fields you send: name, active, priority, eligibleSegments (empty list means everyone). Rule parameters cannot be patched. Deactivated promotions stop applying immediately.

response.name: 400 - empty body
400 - rule parameters cannot be changed

request.description: Deletes a promotion. It stops applying to future quotes and confirms; stored orders keep their audit trail.

exec: pm.test("Total is 21.60 for three mugs", function () { pm.expect(body.total).to.eql("21.60"); });
pm.test("Two promotions applied in order", function () { pm.expect(body.appliedPromotions.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.appliedPromotions[0].sequence).to.eql(1); });

request.description: Prices a cart without reserving stock. Promotions are applied in stage order (category percent, then buy X get Y, then tiered bulk) and listed in the order they were applied. customerSegment is optional (default REGULAR). Duplicate lines are merged.

response.name: 404 - unknown product
400 - empty cart
400 - unknown field

exec: pm.test("Order id and total returned", function () { pm.expect(body.orderId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql("21.60"); });

request.description: Re-prices the cart, locks the stock rows, decrements stock and stores an order in one transaction. The optional Idempotency-Key header (max 100 chars) makes retries safe: the same key with the same cart replays the first order and adds Idempotent-Replayed: true. Saves orderId.

response.name: 201 - replay with the same key (Idempotent-Replayed: true)
422 - same key, different cart
response.body:
{
  "type": "urn:promoquoter:error:idempotency-key-reused",
  "title": "Idempotency key reused",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request",
  "instance": "/api/v1/cart/confirm",
  "code": "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED",
  "requestId": "57752952-4ac7-45d2-9a80-1f798a32d4ed"
}
